Clementine or VLC. VLC is well known for playing absolutely any type of audio or video file, and has good media conversion functionalities. Clementine has superior play-list and library management.

Clementine is the winner then. In spite of generally being very technology oriented, I have extreme reservations about this. Genetic engineering is an incredibly new field and we have an abysmally poor understanding of the causal relationship in human physiology, let alone development. I think one of my biggest concerns is we end up inadvertently creating some really screwed up humans that results in heavy handed regulation whereas once the technology along with our understanding of human physiology matures, this is something we might want to pursue.

I mean there was a time we were literally lobotomizing people as a treatment for various psychological disorders. Most famously for instance JFK's sister in the 40s underwent a lobotomy to 'treat' "mood swings" and "rebellious behavior". Point being that though this process now sounds rather absurd, the leading experts at the time thought it was a smart thing to do.

Or take something more directly related - basic fertility treatment of which this sort of idea is a derivative. Something we've discovered long after the fact is that children produced as a result of in vitro fertilization suffer from major birth defects at a rate 50% higher than 'natural' offspring (~6% as opposed to ~4% respectively) and it's even been linked to slower development and various cancers. Why? Nobody really knows because we still have a very poor understanding of why things happen as they do in our bodies in general. We can describe in extensive detail what is happening within our bodies, but the why is absent. And understanding why something functions as it does is absolutely critical for tweaking things and having them perform as expected.

I think your fear of premature, reactionary legislation is spot-on. These guys will screw up, somewhere. Even if the kid just has the sniffles, but regulators will descend upon this weakly defended group and tear them to shreds, all while empowering themselves. This can, and almost certainly will get ugly.
